03_ai-assistant.status: ACTIVE - the app. Built and verified in the sandbox (27 files / 255 tests, typecheck, both builds, desktop smoke, five end-to-end desktop checks). Ships as a Windows installer; the install on the user's Windows machine is NOT DONE (Priority 1).
03_ai-assistant.tech: Electron 40 + electron-vite 5 + Vite 6 + React 19 + TypeScript 5.7 + Tailwind 4 + Vitest 2; yaml for frontmatter; no other runtime dependency

features_implemented: Browsing Maps: a timeline of what the vault holds (conversations, captured pages, visits) with site grouping, kind filters, search and a time window, read from the vault through /api/vault/sources — a visit is labelled a visit, never reading

Settings > Agent access: switches for the local model, browser captures, keeping conversations and each keyed provider — every one enforced in the main process (refused before anything leaves or is written), with the not-built capabilities stated as such
Every reply labelled where it came from: local, or online · <provider>

Extension port on 127.0.0.1:8765: the browser extension can post captures, read context and capsules, and round-trip the never-check list — capture side only, chrome-extension:// origins only, visible in Settings > System
Real chat against Ollama at 127.0.0.1:11434 with streaming, abort, regenerate, edit-and-resend, branching
Artifacts: extracted from replies, sandboxed preview, code view, version history, ZIP export
Comment mode: append-only rewrite of one artifact at a time with versions
Vault writes: every finished conversation becomes Markdown in the vault, with 09 Activity & Undo appended
Settings as a full window (rail + panes): System, Appearance, Performance, Vault, plus search and per-section Reset
Appearance rewrites the theme tokens themselves (accent, conversation width) and survives reload
Performance: Ollama options from profile presets or custom values, measured against the chosen profile
Vault folder chosen through the main process; missing folders are refused and never replaced

Online providers (Claude/Anthropic, GPT/OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter, Groq, DeepSeek, Grok, any OpenAI-compatible endpoint): off until a key is saved in Settings > Models, key sealed by the machine and never handed to the interface
Cloud models named provider/model and answered through the same /api/ollama/chat address, as the same NDJSON records — one streaming path for local and online alike
Browser preview build that states plainly it is the interface only

Windows installer (NSIS, assisted, per-user, unsigned): AI-ASSistant-Setup-0.1.0.exe (~84 MB) built by electron-builder 26.15.3 from electron-builder.yml, icon rendered from the app's own BrainMark, en-US locale only, maximum compression; release notes in apps/03_ai-assistant/RELEASE-WINDOWS.md
known_gaps: The extension itself is still a starter: it is not loaded, not ported into this app's flow, and captures nothing until it is — so the map is mostly what the app itself kept
Agent access governs what exists (models, captures, keeping, provider keys); Files, Shell, Web and MCP appear as "not built yet" until each one exists
